findings.title: Possible conflict: family income limit
findings.summary: The portal states a limit of ₹6,00,000 while the notification PDF states ₹8,00,000. They may apply to different categories or cycles, so this needs checking.
findings.action: Check the notification's category table and cycle year before relying on either figure.

findings.title: Deadline changed on the official page
findings.summary: Archived versions of the official page show the deadline moving from 15 July 2026 to 31 July 2026. Sources that still say 15 July may be outdated.
findings.action: Confirm the current deadline on the live official page and note the date you checked.

findings.title: Two sources agree but trace to one origin
findings.summary: EduNews and ScholarshipDaily share identical passages, so their matching 15 July deadline is not independent confirmation.
findings.action: Treat them as one source and look for an independent confirmation.

findings.title: Potential gap: renewal conditions
findings.summary: Not found in reviewed sources. Renewal rules may exist in a document that was not added.
findings.action: Search the official guidelines for renewal and continuation rules.

checklist.text: Confirm the current deadline on the live official page
